ops.title: Tailnet board URL 401 on the owner's phone: mesh trust admitted only registered hosts
ops.body: 2026-10-04 5:2x PM PT: owner opened http://yasyf-forge-studio:61118/p/<slug> on iPhone (tailnet node yphone, same Tailscale user yasyfm@) and got 401 unauthorized. cc-interact daemon/httpauth.go authHandler admits loopback, TrustedPeer (synckit meshtrust: self + mesh-registry hosts only), or the bearer token; printed tailnet URLs carry no token and the phone is not a mesh host. Fix: synckit#5 (v0.40.0) trusts same-UserID untagged non-ShareeNode peers; cc-present#19 bumps synckit, lists owner devices in cc-present trust, updates docs. Astra security finder: no admission bypass. Separate: cc-interact v0.35.2 nil-pointer panic in store.AppendEvent via OnPresenceChange during daemon shutdown (daemon.log 2026-10-03 23:10).
